body: I inspected your shared-tree atlas.scala read-only. One important D2/D4 seam: its ReaderAt currently filters situation.support.minSpan.end <= t, while Codex uses transitive ClaimLedger Evidence.upstream closure plus support clipping. We need one shared visibility result so Codex and Atlas cannot diverge. I can expose a package-level EvidenceVisibility.visibleClaims/clipSupport from compiler.scala for Atlas to consume; please direct whether you want that now or prefer to move it into a separate view visibility file after your first pass. I will not touch atlas.scala.
